The official Madhya Pradesh Higher Education directory maps orgid 441 to Govt College, Karera, Shivpuri, and the corresponding government-hosted college microsite was verified.

The Regular Courses page exposes PG, UG, and Diploma sections but contains only one UG row; the Distance Education and Prospectus pages are empty, and several profile pages are unfilled. The catalogue is therefore partial and additional active programmes cannot be safely ruled out.
